frames.title: Meeting Scheduling Software and AI Meeting Tools | Calendly
frames.text:
Introducing the new Calendly, built to handle all of the work around meetings.

Learn more
Product
Solutions
Resources
Pricing
Talk to sales
Log In
Get started for free
All the work around meetings, handled.

From AI-powered scheduling to automated meeting recaps and follow-ups, get the busywork done with fewer tools and less effort.

Sign up with Google
Sign up with Microsoft

Sign up with email • No credit card required

Scheduling
Book meetings with the world’s #1 scheduling tool

Giving you complete control and total customization, Calendly is the easiest and most powerful way to find time to connect.

Learn more
Callie
Beta
Introducing your 24/7 AI scheduling assistant

Add Callie to any email thread to coordinate scheduling on your behalf without switching tools or sacrificing control.

Learn more
Notetaker
New
Actionable, shareable recaps for every meeting

Finish the day knowing every meeting was captured, next steps were tracked, and follow-ups were handled.

Learn more
Payments
New
Flexible, built-in payment tools

Charge upfront for meetings, sell packages, and send invoices with payment features that make it easy to get paid.

Learn more
AI MEETING MANAGEMENT
Built for people whose work runs on meetings

Meetings move you forward, but the work around them can slow you down. Calendly handles the tasks before, during, and after meetings, so you have more space for what matters.

Start for free
Book

A client emails asking to meet. Share a booking link or ask Callie, your AI assistant, to find times that work for everyone.

Callie replies with times to meet
Client picks Tuesday at 2 p.m.
Client pays $150 deposit upfront


Prep

Never walk into a meeting cold.

Capture

Focus on the conversation. Notetaker handles the notes.

Follow up

Work moves forward after the meeting ends.

Scheduling
A better way to book your meetings

Full control over your calendar

Connect your calendars, set your hours, and control exactly when you're available to meet.

Meeting templates for every scenario

From one-on-one calls to multi-host meetings, pre-built event types make scheduling easy for everyone.

Automated email & text workflows

Reduce no-shows with personalized email and text reminders, and let invitees reschedule when needed without the back-and-forth.

Website embeds and routing forms

Let visitors schedule right from your website. Add routing forms to qualify leads and match them with the right team member.

Scheduling whenever, wherever

Access Calendly from the mobile app or browser extension, or use it with your favorite AI tool, LinkedIn, or 150+ other integrations.

Tools for teams of all sizes

Grow your business with scheduling that scales. Add teammates, set permissions, and manage access without switching tools.

Callie
Beta
Meet Callie, your AI assistant
Conversational scheduling

Instead of managing scheduling links and calendars yourself, just add callie@calendly.com to the email thread. Say what you need and let Callie take it from there.

Precise coordination
24/7 assistance with meeting tasks
Notetaker
New
Actionable recaps for every meeting
Clear summaries with next steps

End every call with meeting summaries and next steps, so nothing falls through the cracks.

Pre-drafted follow-up emails
Works with your tools
Instant meeting recall
Payments
New
Flexible payment options that fit your business
Upfront meeting payments

Collect payment when clients book with you, so you can get paid sooner and reduce no-shows.

Meeting packages
Invoices
Payment links
CUSTOMER STORIES
Real customers. Real results.
$1,200 annual savings
“

I use Calendly every single day. Without it, I honestly couldn’t run my business.”

Pua Pakele
Founder at RBL Media
100% attendance rate
“

Adding a booking fee didn’t just reduce no-shows — it changed the tone of my consultations.”

Elizabeth Saunders
Founder at Real Life E
75 hours saved monthly
“

Calendly helps us protect our team’s time and make every support interaction count.”

Marques Stewart
Managing Director of Technology at Achievement First
80% reduction in booking-related emails
“

We care deeply about the experience they have with us — and Calendly helps us start it off right.”

Akira Bradley
Co-Founder at Barking with the Bradley’s
3 to 5 hours saved per week
“

Notetaker organizes the chaos of dialogue into clarity.”

Lizzie Lewis
Founder at Kitty of Angels
150+ INTEGRATIONS
Connect Calendly with your favorite tools

Our extensive list of integrations makes Calendly flexible.

View all integrations

Google suite

Get your job done faster by connecting Calendly to Google Calendar, Meet, Analytics, and more.

Microsoft suite

Make your day easier with Calendly integrations for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Azure SSO, and more.

GET STARTED
From the first meeting to the follow-up

All of the work around meetings, handled in one place. Book time, capture every discussion, and keep next steps moving without the manual work.

Start for free
